outcomes.statement: The automated-provisioning aggregate is closed from traceable verification of canonical deliveries US-063 through US-066, without duplicating their implementation.
outcomes.demo: Three timestamped AC verifications cite the official child evidence, the current repository build passes once, no application or package code changes, and the terminal US-019 event unblocks its dependent stories.

uncertainties.statement: Whether closing the aggregate requires new provisioning implementation.
uncertainties.resolution: CHG-054 establishes verification-only closure: US-063 delivers the invitation path, US-064 the no-seat path, US-065 failure and retry, and US-066 accepted-invite activation. No application, package, migration, runtime, test, or executable-tooling change is allowed.

uncertainties.statement: Whether parent verification requires another authoritative mutation campaign.
uncertainties.resolution: The canonical children retain their authoritative mutation evidence, this assessment changes no mutatable source, and preflight calculates zero shards. Run no parent cold campaign unless evidence inspection identifies a genuine new need, and never more than one.

uncertainties.statement: Whether every parent acceptance criterion has complete canonical child evidence.
uncertainties.resolution: AC1 is jointly evidenced by US-063 invitation delivery and US-065 failure/retry; AC2 by US-066 accepted-invite activation; AC3 by US-064 no-seat routing. Each child is dev_done with passing adversarial verification, aggregate build evidence, and a terminal authoritative mutation report.
